## Frontend Review Checklist

- [ ] View/container/hook boundaries are intentional
- [ ] API-shaped data is validated with DTOs or schemas
- [ ] State ownership is clear
- [ ] Existing UI components and tokens are reused
- [ ] Accessibility impact was checked
- [ ] Performance impact was considered
- [ ] New dependency impact was reviewed, or no dependency was added
